title: Bills 128 and 129 for countywide water upgrades
summary: Bill 129 FD1, which authorizes a loan from the state's drinking water revolving fund for water supply projects, was taken up on October 23. The bill first surfaced September 29 as a proposed loan from the Drinking Water State Revolving Fund. Also that day, Bill 128 would re-fund $3 million for countywide water upgrades after last year's money lapsed, and a first-reading vote was taken.

timeline.text: Bill 129 FD1 authorizes a loan from the state's drinking water revolving fund for water supply projects.
Bill 129 would allow a loan from the state's Drinking Water State Revolving Fund for water supply projects.
